findings.title: SQL Injection in Dynamic Query Construction
findings.evidence: f-string SQL construction with user-controlled column names despite allowlist
findings.impact: Database compromise, data exfiltration, privilege escalation
findings.recommended_fix: Add defense-in-depth SQL validation layer; use parameterized queries for all dynamic components

findings.title: Use of Weak Cryptographic Hash (MD5/SHA1) for Security Purposes
findings.evidence: hashlib.md5() used for cache key generation in security-sensitive contexts
findings.impact: Collision attacks could bypass cache integrity checks, enable cache poisoning
findings.recommended_fix: Replace MD5/SHA1 with SHA-256 or BLAKE3: hashlib.blake2b() or hashlib.sha256()

findings.title: 116 Known Vulnerabilities in Python Dependencies
findings.impact: Remote code execution, information disclosure, denial of service via exploited dependencies
findings.recommended_fix: pip install pillow==12.1.1 flask==3.1.3; run 'pip install --upgrade -r requirements.txt'

findings.title: Overly Permissive Security Group Egress Rules (0.0.0.0/0)
findings.evidence: egress cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] for HTTPS and MongoDB Atlas ports
findings.impact: Data exfiltration path if instance compromised; violates least-privilege principle
findings.recommended_fix: Restrict egress to specific CIDR blocks for MongoDB Atlas IPs; use VPC endpoints for AWS services

findings.title: Fake Private Keys in Test Files
findings.impact: Low risk (fake keys), but indicates potential for real secret leakage; may trigger false positives in secret scanners
findings.recommended_fix: Replace with placeholder tokens like '{{FAKE_PRIVATE_KEY}}' or use pytest fixtures

findings.title: CI Workflow Secrets Exposure Risk
findings.evidence: GITHUB_TOKEN persisted in .git/config without cleanup after checkout
findings.impact: Token exfiltration if artifact upload step maliciously modified; supply chain attack vector
findings.recommended_fix: Continue current persist-credentials: false pattern; ensure token cleanup steps remain

findings.title: Missing Pagination Limits on Large Dataset Queries
findings.evidence: SELECT * FROM logs without LIMIT clause in admin endpoint
findings.impact: Memory exhaustion, slow response times, potential DoS via large result sets
findings.recommended_fix: Enforce max limit=1000; add cursor-based pagination for large datasets

findings.title: Missing Structured Logging in Error Paths
findings.evidence: logger.warning(f"pg supa_get_user failed: {e}") without correlation IDs
findings.impact: Difficult incident response, inability to trace requests across services
findings.recommended_fix: Add correlation_id=uuid.uuid4() to all error logs; use structured logging format

findings.title: Test Coverage Below Target Threshold
findings.evidence: fail_under = 70 but actual coverage unknown without running tests
findings.impact: Undetected regressions, reduced confidence in refactoring
findings.recommended_fix: Run pytest --cov and address gaps; target 80%+ coverage for critical paths

findings.title: Outdated API Schema Documentation
findings.evidence: Schema drift from actual OpenAPI spec generated by FastAPI
findings.recommended_fix: Auto-generate schema in CI: openapi.json export step; add schema validation gate

findings.title: Mixed License Dependencies Detected
findings.evidence: Dependencies include MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, GPL-licensed packages
findings.impact: Potential license compliance issues if GPL packages linked into proprietary distribution
findings.recommended_fix: Run license scanner (pip-licenses); document all licenses in COMPLIANCE.md
